description.value:
Armax Arsenal builds the Gemini for one thing: cycling the user's element zero nodes back to readiness as fast as the nervous system will tolerate. It adds no strength to a biotic's fields, only tempo.

Armax Arsenal · III

  • Recharge −3: your biotic powers' cooldowns are 1 round (4 − 3, minimum 1). Powers with a fixed cooldown of their own, such as Biotic Charge, keep it.

A bio-amp plugs into a biotic implant (or rests against the nervous system of a naturally biotic species, like the asari). Amps don't stack: if you wear more than one, you get only the highest of each bonus.

Wear it to gain its bonuses. Item bonuses from amps don't stack with other item bonuses to the same thing, such as a Power Amplifier's damage or a Biotic Feedback Generator's class DC. The Vanguard automation applies the Recharge and barrier bonus itself; other biotics count their cooldowns by hand.
